Findings remain advisory only. Ordinary numeric and -p releases remain unresolved because isolated patches can leave product metadata unchanged; live stores and patch provenance are not verified.
Android telephony is outside this macOS endpoint product. Carrier/device patch verification requires an Android control plane; no Allay prevention is asserted.

TV-2026-1012 add-ons, loaded decoders and helper execution remain unverified. Update/relaunch clients and verify each Remote Management component separately; inventory does not prevent the helper race or malicious sessions.

Findings remain advisory only. July and October findings remain separate. Feature prerequisites, deployed files, unreviewed branches and remote sites remain unverified.

Android Framework/System and vendor patch levels are outside the local macOS inventory and hook boundary. Device administrators must verify the installed Android security patch level against the bulletin; Allay cannot verify phone remediation.

The researcher describes iOS and Android browser exploit chains. Allay does not inventory phones or inspect browser payloads; update affected mobile devices and investigate exposure through the mobile owner. No campaign or compromised-site hostname is added to blocking policy.

Barracuda appliance administration is outside the Mac endpoint boundary. Local clients and outbound hostname matches do not establish firmware protection; the appliance owner must apply product-specific patches, restrict administrative access and investigate compromise.

Installed npm @better-auth/expo and better-auth now have separate tested stable/beta version findings. Plugin registration, companion-version pairing, reachable endpoints and secret rotation remain unknown; update both packages, redeploy and rotate exposed application secrets. This is metadata advice, not account-takeover prevention.

Chrome app metadata now reports the November stable update baseline separately from October, with old/fixed/unknown and unrelated-browser regressions. Relaunch and running-build verification remain manual; Chromium/Electron copies and browser exploitation are not mediated.

UCS Central web-management requests execute on the remote management appliance, outside Allay agent hooks and Mac inventory. The asset owner must verify the UCS Central update and authorized access; no Mac application version substitutes for that assessment.

APT download verification and privileged package installation occur on Debian hosts or Linux guests. Allay does not inspect their package manager or mediate its post-verification file handling. Update APT through the distribution and verify the host package; Mac download reputation is not a fix.

Docker confirms host Git execution from sandbox-controlled repository configuration, but Allay has no Sandboxes-specific offline version discovery or hook on Docker host-side Git. Add a bounded vendor-verified sbx metadata reader and affected/fixed/unknown fixtures, distinct from Docker Desktop versions. Upgrade Sandboxes and review writable mounts; ordinary Git commands and skill scanning do not establish prevention.

Homebrew core freerdp receipts now produce tested 3.x update findings for the 3.32.2 security baseline; custom/HEAD builds and other branches remain unresolved. Embedded libraries, enabled channels, peer trust and running sessions are not checked. Update/rebuild and restart consumers; no RDP traffic inspection is added.

Exact npm node-red metadata now triggers a tested configuration review at every version, including unknown versions. The Siemens Industrial OS fix is not an npm version cutoff. Allay does not evaluate settings.js, verify effective adminAuth/reachability or inspect running flows; the operator must secure the editor/admin API and review deployed flows.

NoMachine confirms an all-platform web-player issue, but the inventory has no verified Web Player component identity/version reader. Add bounded edition/component metadata discovery and branch-specific fixtures after verifying macOS packaging; do not infer nxwebrunner from an arbitrary NoMachine display name or a client cask. Restrict web-player access and apply the vendor fix independently.

The vulnerable report deserialization and certificate-name authorization run on Puppet/OpenVox servers. A managed Mac agent can receive malicious actions from a compromised controller, but its local version cannot establish server remediation and Allay has no controller/CA integration. Server owners must update server components, verify authorization rules and investigate exposed CA keys and managed nodes.

Ruby runtime inventory does not discover the activestorage gem or verify ImageMagick policy, MiniMagick environment overrides and Disk-service exposure. Add a bounded non-evaluating installed-gem metadata reader with four-component version tests and discovery fixtures; never execute gemspecs. Application owners must update Active Storage/MiniMagick, verify effective policy and rotate exposed secrets.

The affected address rules and file-transfer workers run in a SEPPmail gateway appliance, not in a Mac mail client. Allay cannot inspect incoming gateway processing or active appliance rules. Gateway owners must update firmware, verify relevant features and investigate suspicious messages/files.

The vendor confirms authenticated command injection affecting a remotely controlled host, but the reviewed advisory/CNA record does not establish which macOS targets or components, if any, are affected. Allay has no Dameware-specific inventory or remote-control mediation. Verify target-platform/component applicability with SolarWinds before adding Mac identities or ranges; update the Dameware control deployment per the vendor.

SonicWall CNA records identify GMS on Windows/Linux as affected and unsupported. Its management service and database are outside the Mac endpoint inventory. The PSIRT HTML was an empty shell; vendor-authored CNA records verify product/platform scope. The asset owner must isolate and replace the unsupported service and confirm migration guidance with SonicWall.

AuthPoint Authentication Gateway runs on Windows Server and is distinct from the macOS Logon app. Allay does not verify gateway LDAP/RADIUS callbacks, inter-service TLS or replay protection. The gateway owner must update the gateway and verify service activation; a Mac client update cannot establish remediation.

Xen grant-copy isolation is a hypervisor boundary, outside macOS inventory and agent hooks. Allay cannot patch or verify dom0 or other guests. Hypervisor owners must apply Xen/distribution fixes and verify host activation; VM image or application updates are insufficient.
